question: Can even vast material wealth justify giving this kaula teaching to the unworthy?
premises: That wealth could fill an ocean with jewels
Such wealth is contrasted with the teaching's value
inference: Even the ability to fill an ocean with jewels is not sufficient reason to give this teaching improperly.
uncertainties: ratnasaṃpūrṇamakretuṃ is a fused and irregular transmitted form
plain_english: Even if one had the accumulation to make an ocean filled with jewels.
